discovery_metadata.description: Bounded JSON compact, validation and parse-once pointer selection backed by pinned serde_json without external authority.

apis.delta: Bounded JSON parse and compact serialization; sorted object keys, last duplicate key wins, no lexical number preservation or JCS claim.
Copied list<u8> input; invalid UTF-8 is invalid-json. Bounded JSON parse and compact serialization; sorted object keys, last duplicate key wins, no lexical number preservation or JCS claim.
Same bounded compact text semantics with exactly the caller fallback on a documented JsonError.
Same bounded compact-bytes parse/serialization; returns the caller-supplied owned fallback on any JsonError. No lossy UTF8 and no external authority.
Same bounded JSON validation, followed by serde_json UTF8 string decoding. Return exactly caller fallback on non-string values or documented JsonError.

Plain record view of the existing parse-once selected-value batch: valid=true and complete values on success; valid=false/empty values/documented error on failure. Same bounds and no partial publication.
Parses once and selects at most 64 strict JSON pointers; None means missing, Some(null) means JSON null; selected JSON strings share a 65536-byte output cap.

Copied list<u8> input; invalid UTF-8 is invalid-json. Parses once and selects at most 64 strict JSON pointers; None means missing, Some(null) means JSON null; selected JSON strings share a 65536-byte output cap.
Same bounded pointer selection; decode a selected JSON string to owned UTF8 text. Return caller fallback for missing, non-string values or any JsonError. Original eight APIs unchanged.

Record view of select: present distinguishes missing from JSON null; json carries the same bounded compact JSON value. Reuses the same single parse, pointer order, errors and shared 65536-byte output cap.
Copied list<u8> record view of select-bytes, with exact UTF-8 validation and present/json fields. Reuses the same parse and bounds; no Host access.
Input is UTF-8 JSON text bounded to 65536 bytes and 64 open containers; parser failures become invalid-json with no partial result.
